title: Note Process File Frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of config/note-processes/<template-stem>.md — instance-local, user-owned settings for /note on one template. The file body is free guidance text. A file holding only offer: never (no other field and no body) is a decline marker; an offer: never file with other fields or a body reads as a normal process with declined false. Documentation only: lib/note_process.py validates these fields itself.

destination.description: Vault folder the note moves to by default: a relative vault folder, with or without a trailing '/' (no leading '/' or '~', no drive letter, no backslash, no blank or dot-led segment, no '{{' or '<%', no control or invisible character except U+200C and U+200D; rules in lib/note_paths.py). It is normalised to exactly one trailing '/' on read and on write; a refused value makes the file read as broken. Overrides concepts.atomic_note.path for this template.

required.description: Point names (headings, frontmatter keys or open tokens of the template outline) that may not stay empty.

offer.description: When present alone (no other field and no body), the user declined saving a process for this template; /note does not offer again.
